Method of Attack: Phishing attacks via Microsoft Teams group chat requests pushing malicious attachments
Malware payload installation via double extension file 'Navigating Future Changes October 2023.pdf.msi'
Malware includes concealed VNC, Windows Defender bypass tools, browser history theft, reverse proxy, file manager, Discord token stealer
Impacted Systems: Organizations using Microsoft Teams with External Access enabled
Attack Vector: Malicious Microsoft Teams group chat invites from compromised or spoofed accounts
Phishing via Teams messages with malicious MSI attachments
Exploitation of Microsoft Teams External Access feature allowing external tenant messaging
